morphology-basic.svg.source:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="64" height="64">
<defs>
 <filter id="erode" x="-.5" y="-.5" width="2" height="2"><feMorphology radius="2"/></filter>
 <filter id="dilate" x="-.5" y="-.5" width="2" height="2"><feMorphology operator="dilate" radius="2"/></filter>
 <filter id="color" x="-.5" y="-.5" width="2" height="2" color-interpolation-filters="sRGB"><feMorphology operator="dilate" radius="2"/></filter>
 <filter id="alpha" x="-.5" y="-.5" width="2" height="2"><feMorphology operator="erode" in="SourceAlpha" radius="1 2"/></filter>
</defs>
<rect x="5" y="5" width="22" height="20" fill="#c43" filter="url(#erode)"/>
<rect x="38" y="8" width="16" height="14" fill="#39b" filter="url(#dilate)"/>
<g filter="url(#color)"><rect x="6" y="39" width="9" height="15" fill="red" fill-opacity=".5"/><rect x="15" y="39" width="9" height="15" fill="blue" fill-opacity=".75"/></g>
<path d="M38 37H57V43H49V57H43V43H38Z" fill="#693" filter="url(#alpha)"/>
</svg>

morphology-units.svg.source:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="64" height="64">
<defs>
 <filter id="box" primitiveUnits="objectBoundingBox" x="-.5" y="-.5" width="2" height="2"><feMorphology radius=".125 .25" operator="dilate"/></filter>
 <filter id="m" x="-.5" y="-.5" width="2" height="2"><feMorphology radius="1 2" operator="erode"/></filter>
 <filter id="grow" x="-.5" y="-.5" width="2" height="2"><feMorphology radius="2 1" operator="dilate"/></filter>
</defs>
<rect x="8" y="8" width="16" height="12" fill="#d64" filter="url(#box)"/>
<g transform="translate(35 6) scale(2 1.5)"><rect width="10" height="12" fill="#29a" filter="url(#m)"/></g>
<g transform="translate(16 47) rotate(25)"><rect x="-8" y="-6" width="16" height="12" fill="#7a4" filter="url(#grow)"/></g>
<g transform="translate(46 47) skewX(25)"><rect x="-8" y="-7" width="16" height="14" fill="#a58" filter="url(#m)"/></g>
</svg>

morphology-graph.svg.source:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="64" height="64">
<defs>
 <filter id="outline" x="-.5" y="-.5" width="2" height="2"><feMorphology operator="dilate" radius="2" in="SourceAlpha" result="thick"/><feComposite in="thick" in2="SourceAlpha" operator="out" result="ring"/><feFlood flood-color="#a35"/><feComposite in2="ring" operator="in"/></filter>
 <filter id="opening" x="-.5" y="-.5" width="2" height="2"><feMorphology radius="1"/><feMorphology operator="dilate" radius="1"/></filter>
 <filter id="clipped" filterUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x="2" y="34" width="27" height="26"><feFlood flood-color="#296" x="8" y="39" width="14" height="15"/><feMorphology operator="dilate" radius="3"/></filter>
 <filter id="shift" x="-.5" y="-.5" width="2" height="2"><feMorphology operator="dilate" radius="1" result="m"/><feOffset dx="3" dy="2"/><feMerge><feMergeNode/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge></filter>
</defs>
<rect x="8" y="8" width="15" height="15" fill="#269" filter="url(#outline)"/>
<path d="M38 6H54V14H57V15H54V23H38Z" fill="#c85" filter="url(#opening)"/>
<rect x="6" y="38" width="18" height="16" filter="url(#clipped)"/>
<rect x="39" y="38" width="13" height="15" fill="#36c" fill-opacity=".6" filter="url(#shift)"/>
</svg>
